Priya: Heads-up — NexLoop usage dropped ~72% over the last 14 days. Champion Alyssa (ML lead) left last week; procurement kicked off an RFP and we saw a spike in demos with BrightLayer. Their trial renews 2025-06-12. Flagging as at-risk — thoughts?
Marc: Ack. Analytics shows active seats down, inference endpoint calls down 60%, and a bunch of users are inactive. They also toggled off auto-batching late last week.
Jonah: Any product feedback or errors from them? What's the main pain they reported in demos? /cc @Evelyn
Evelyn: Pulled logs — intermittent 500s during large-batch runs on 2025-04-28. Logged as #5643. They also asked for a lower-cost model in last demo (quantized).
Priya: Quick triage plan: 1) Marc reach out to procurement for RFP vendor list and timeline. 2) Jonah draft a 30-day trial extension + 20% Dedicated discount proposal. 3) Evelyn prepare ops mitigations and a temp quantized profile to reduce cost.
Marc: On it. Drafting outreach to procurement now. I'll ask for the RFP scope and expected award date. Will also ask if BrightLayer is on their shortlist.
Jonah: I'll draft the commercial note. Question: can we legitimately offer a quantized profile in a trial without breaking SLAs?
Evelyn: Yes — we can stand up a q4_0 profile for them with prefix caching. Tradeoff: ~+15% median latency, ~-35% per-token cost. I'll include config snippet and a short perf/cost comparison.
Evelyn: ```
model: redwood/q4_0
cache: prefix_enabled
batching: adaptive
```
Marc: I asked procurement for usage metrics they want and attached current cost delta. Offered an exec QBR slot next Wed 11am PT; they're checking availability.
Priya: If we can get a QBR with their CTO and the procurement lead, we should demo the quantized profile + cost math and offer a time-limited committed discount.
Jonah: I'll include a one-page ROI sheet comparing current hosted profile vs q4_0 + batching savings and the Dedicated discount scenario.
Priya: Owners: Marc (procurement outreach), Jonah (commercial + ROI), Evelyn (ops config + logs). I'll follow up in 48h with a status update. :thumbsup:
